title: DM token derived from group ID is static
description: SPEC l.2461 derives the DM routing token from the MLS group ID, so it never rotates and links all DM traffic across epochs for the relay. Fix: derive per-epoch via MLS exporter like channel tokens. Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
